## Welcome

The Bureau of Regional Statistics publishes quarterly statistical releases on regional employment and economic indicators. 
Our latest release covers **Q3 2026** for the **Oregon** region.

## Latest release

| Indicator | Value |
|---|---|
| Non-farm payroll, health care | 271.4k |
| Non-farm payroll, construction | 112.8k |
| Non-farm payroll, manufacturing | 189.2k |

See the [methodology notes](https://example.gov/brs) for details on seasonal adjustment and rounding.
